content: Pedro sogsad, igi Judíoʼsurmalad Bab-Jesús-abingasmarmoga
Jesús-e-sapingan-bur-dummagan, degi, gwenadgan-Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad Judeaʼgi-bukwamalad, itoarmalad, dulemar-Judíoʼsurmalad Bab-Dummad-gayaburba abingasmarmoye.
Pedro Jerusalénʼse gannar nonigu, Judíoʼmar-Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad, Pedroʼse uluarmalad,
ega sogdemalad: —¿Ibiga Judíoʼsurmalad-negyaba be dogdii? ¿Ibiga eba be mas gundibali? ¿Wede isesursi?
Agi Pedro ibmar-gebe-gualid-akar, ilekwaa bela amarga sogdesunnad:
—Jope-neggweburgi an mai, Bab-Dummadse an gorsigu, negburgan an daksad. Agi, mola-sibu-dummadyobi, e-dukumar-bakegwadgi-atinnar nibneggi anse aidedani an daksad.

Nue an dakdegu, an dakalid, galagwensuli we-napneggi ibmar-durgan-unimalad, achu-sapur-ursilimalad, ibdurgan-napagi-musgimakdimalad, degi, ibdula-sakan-nikamaladi, a-mola-sibu-dummadyagi, bukwa an dakalid.
”Degi, dule niba anse gole an itosad: ‘Pedro, be gwisgu, we-ibmar be oburgwe, be gunne.’
An abin-sogded: ‘Dummad, suli, an gunnosuli, ar ibmar-isgana, ibmar-isemaladi gwen an-gaya-yaba dogdisulid.’
Degi, dule niba gannar anse gollarbalid: ‘Bab-Dummad ibmar-ised-osulosadi, mer isedye be bar bie.’
Weyob-gusadi, ilapaa gannar-gannar anga soglesad. A-sorbali, gannar bela we-ibmar niba seledgusad.
”A-sorbali, dulemar-warbaa Cesarea-neggwebur-akar an-aminonimalad, an-neg-maidse nonimalad.
Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled anga sokalid: ‘Eba be nae, mer benguo.’ Wemar-gwenadgan-walanergwadi (6) anba nadmarmogad, degi, dule-anse-gorsiid-negse an dogdapmarsunnad.
Agi, a-dule anmarga sokalid, igi e-neggi ede baliwitur-gwichi daksa, ega soge: ‘Jope-neggweburse Simónʼbina-naega dulemar be barmidye, a-dulede, Pedroʼye-bimarye.
A-Simón-Pedro bega sunmaknonikoye, agi, be abonolegoye, degi, bela be-negginmalad abonolemogoye, ega soge itosad.’
”A-neggi an sunmakgwichi Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled Judíoʼsurmaladgi aidenonikid, igi gebesaila anmargi aidenonigusmogadyob gusmogad.

Degi, Bab-Jesús-anmarga-ibmar-sogsad insaas an naded, deun, sogsagusgu: ‘Ar Juanʼdi Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imaksadi, unnila diigi dulemar-ogsaye, bemardi Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledgi oglemaloye.’

Anmar Bab-Jesucristoʼgi-bensulidba Bab-Dummad anmarga E-Burba-Isligwaled uksad. Ayobi, Bab-Dummad dule-Judíoʼsurmaladga E-Burba-Isligwaled uksamogad. Degite, ¿ande doasunna, Bab-Dummad igar an bisgeye soger? Geg an bisge.”

Bela Pedro-ega-ibmar-sogsad itosmargu, bogidik ambikusmalad. Geb degi, Bab-Dummad-nug ogannodmarsunnad, sogdemalad: “Bab-Dummad, Judíoʼsurmalad na e-isguedga ulubgi-bukib-binsaed ega uksamogad, e-daed ogwaegar, adi, nabir burba-geg-bergued nikumarmogagar.”
Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-Antioquíaʼgi-bukwamalad

Degidgine, Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad, Esteban-oburgwilesad-sorba-baregilleargu, aisakid gusmalad. Gwen-gwen Fenicia-yarse, Chipre-yarse, degi, Antioquía-neggweburse nadegusmalad. Amar unnila Bab-Jesús-gayaburbagi Judíoʼmargarbi sunmaksamalad. Dulemar-baigangardi, gwen sunmaksasurmalad.
Degi-inigwele, gwenadgan-aisakid-gusmalad gwen-gwen Chipreʼginmaladid, degi, Cireneʼginmaladid. Amar Antioquíaʼse modapmargu, Griego-dulemarga Bab-Jesús-gayaburba-nuedgi sunmakdapmalad.
A-gwenadganba Bab-Dummad-gangued nue-gudigusoggu, bukidar Bab-Jesúsʼgi bengussurmalad, Bab-Jesúsʼba nagusmalad.
Jerusalénʼgi Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunonidamalad itoarmargu, Antioquía-neggweburgi Judíoʼsurmalad Bab-Jesúsʼba nagusmarmoye, Antioquíaʼse Bernabé-barmiar gusmalad.

Bernabé Antioquíaʼse nonigu, daknonikid, Bab-Dummad Judíoʼmargi nued binsasayobi, Judíoʼsurmaladgi nued binsasmogad. Bernabé degi-daksagu, weligwar itosad, degi, gwenadgan-ogannoarsunnad, mer Bab-Jesús-igargi galakumaloye, ega sokarsunnad.
Ar ade, Bernabéʼde dule-nueddaed, degi, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled nue-nikabalid. Antioquíaʼgi bukidar dulemar e-gwagegi Bab-Jesús-abingasmarbalid.
A-sorba, Bernabé, Saulo-aminaega Tarso-neggweburse nadegusad. Bernabé Saulo-amisgu, Antioquíaʼse Saulo-senonikid.

Agine, Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunonidamalad-walik birgagwen gudigusmalad, Jesús-igargi dulemar-bukidar-odurdakdii gusmalad. Deun, a-neggweburgi gebe Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad, Cristianoʼye bilenonimalad.
A-ibagangi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad Jerusalénʼgi-bukwad, Antioquíaʼse nonimalad.

Agi Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-wargwen, Agaboʼye-nugadi sunmakdii gualid, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled-nikadba dulemarga sokalid: Bela we-napneg-naidgi, ukud-dummad daniye. Dakleargu, Claudio Romaʼgi dummadga maiunni, Agabo-sogsadyob gusad.
Degisoggu, Antioquíaʼgi-Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad, gwenadgan-Judeaʼgi-bukwamalad-bendake guarmalad. Na ibmar-nikadba ukdemalad.
Degisoggu, gwenadgan-bendakega Sauloʼba, degi, Bernabéʼba, gwenadgan-idudimalad-Judeaʼgi-bukwamaladga ibmar barmismalad.
